text:
sara-security: alert from rate-anomaly: sudden websocket connection fanout to /ws/replicate across multiple edge POPs, ~180k new connections in 3m, many short-lived, source IPs rotating via residential proxies. UA shows 'python-requests/2.x' + header 'X-Session-Seed'. suspect traffic abuse, potential credential stuffing or proxy pool. incident-bot: incident created SEC-THREAT-2025-WS-01 :rotating_light:

max-oncall: acknowledging. can we get immediate containment at edge? prioritise blocking path /ws/replicate + per-src conn limit. push WAF rule + connrate at edge. i'll take lead.

ev an-edges: rolling a quick edge rule now. plan: 1) apply per-src concurrent connection cap 30 2) per-src RPM 600 with 1m sliding window 3) strict header fingerprinting to catch rotating proxies (X-Session-Seed pattern). will push as staged rule to POPs in 2m.

priya-platops: also check for auth token creation spikes. if keys were created recently, revoke suspect keys and check KMS unwrap logs. i will query audit logs for key unwraps and token minting events.

laura-cust-comms: heads-up, customer-impact: embeddings/replicate path degraded for some customers using websocket ingestion. need an internal notice and a short customer bulletin if we expect >5% errors longer than 30m. collecting ETA.

dmitri-ml-infra: running quick log grep across ingest-gw: `jq -r '.remote_ip + " " + .path + " " + .user_agent' logs.json | grep "/ws/replicate" | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head` - early signal shows top 1000 IPs each only 1-3 requests then rotate. indicates proxy farm. no obvious auth header reuse yet.

max-oncall: deploy-bot, roll edge rule to POPs with id ws-fanout-block-01, staged rollout 10%, then 50%. monitor latency and 5xx rate.

deploy-bot: applied ws-fanout-block-01 to edge-pop-3 (10% rollout).

ev an-edges: WAF snippet i'm applying (pseudocode):
```
if request.path == "/ws/replicate":
  if conn_count(src_ip) > 30 or rpm(src_ip) > 600:
    action block
  elif header.matches("X-Session-Seed", /[a-f0-9]{40}/) and ua contains "python-requests":
    action challenge (captcha-like) or rate_limit
```
rolling to more POPs in 3m.

priya-platops: KMS audit quick check: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND timestamp>\"2025-03-01T00:00:00Z\""` — no abnormal unwraps in last 24h. token issuance (internal-oauth) shows spike in refresh token exchanges from 3 service accounts at 12:03 UTC; i'm isolating which clients used those. if suspect, we'll rotate those service keys and create emergency RBAC rule to prevent new key creation by non-admin roles.

laura-cust-comms: copy — if we rotate keys, should prepare KB for customers explaining short-lived credential rotation and why it's safe. prioritize customers on Dedicated and Private for extra notes.

dmitri-ml-infra: vuln triage note: check upstream rate-limiter for header spoof bypass where X-Forwarded-For was used to bypass per-src limits. i see haproxy config had `option forwardfor` but no strict trust-proxy in some POPs. ticketing it now: INFRA-3456.

sara-security: good catch. add RBAC lockdown: new permission `edge_rules.modify` should be limited to two owners until postmortem. priya, can you create the temp policy?

priya-platops: done. created policy patch restricting `edge_rules.modify` to @[evan-edges] and @[max-oncall] for 24h. logged change in audit.

max-oncall: edge rules escalated dropped the abnormal fanout ~6m after rollout, connection spike down to baseline. continuing monitoring. will keep rule active while we finish triage. :thumbsup:

laura-cust-comms: drafting customer notice template now. short summary + impact + mitigation steps + link to post-incident page. will share draft here in 30m.

dmitri-ml-infra: next steps for post-incident: 1) full log correlation across POPs (start at 12:00-12:10) 2) validate no KMS key misuse 3) RBAC audit (who changed rules) 4) remediation: add proxy trust config and tighten per-connection defaults 5) update runbooks. i'll open postmortem ticket and assign owners.

incident-bot: postmortem ticket created PM-SEC-2025-WS-01, link: https://redwood/pm/PM-SEC-2025-WS-01

max-oncall: closing operational thread for now. assigning follow-ups: dmitri=log-correlation, priya=RBAC+KMS audit, laura=customer comms, evan=permanent edge rule + proxy trust fix. if anything reappears ping #oncall.

sara-security: thanks team. we'll do a 1-hr sync after everyone has initial findings. :white_check_mark:
